title: 武则天：唯一的女皇帝
title_en: Wu Zetian, the Only Empress to Rule Alone
blurb_en: A palace girl with three tools for taming a horse ends up ruling China, and leaves a blank tombstone.
blurb_zh: 她说管一匹马只要三样东西。后来她当上了皇帝，死后留下一块没有字的石碑。
